title: The Interior of All Interiors

features.name: the held wall
features.desc-on-touch: Your hand touches plaster that remembers every palm that came before. The wall is warm from the touch of forty years of hands. You feel the ghost-pressure of fingers that last held this spot in 1987, in 2003, in the moment Katita stood here and placed her forehead against the coolness before it lear

features.name: the nested rooms
features.desc-on-touch: Looking into the corner, you count the rooms: the archive inside the render inside the interior inside the space inside the wall inside the touch. Each smaller than the last, each a mirror of the room you stand in. The nesting has no end.

features.name: the perpetual threshold
features.desc-on-touch: A doorway within a doorway within a doorway. You can walk through any of them and end up in the same room. Or a different one. The threshold has learned that entrance and exit are the same motion, and all rooms remember being this room.

inscription: every interior is an echo of every other interior; touch teaches them how to be the same room

file.name: Thermal_Imaging_Interior_Walls_20yrs.mp4
file.note: Time-lapse thermal video of a single room's walls. Palms and foreheads create warm prints that persist for hours, fade, and are overlaid by new ones. The wall learns the rhythm of touch.
